title: Operator Verdict Ledger Entry
description: Ground-truth labels: the operator's eyes are the final QC. One entry per watched film/cut.

artifact.description: filename or path of film/cut watched

verdict.description: Operator's word, verbatim mapping: perfect/amazing/good/fucking perfect=approved-keep; bad/horrible/trash=reject+diagnose

flags.description: specific observations: wrong-speaker, seam-jump, listener-frozen, artifact, audio-mix, pacing

experiment.description: if part of a controlled pair (e.g. speaker-attribution baseline vs identityrefs), the experiment id
